ky_a_hole_wall.blurb: A-Hole Wall is one of four cliff lines that make up the Hole in the Wall cluster in the Red River Gorge. It is a sport wall with about ten bolted lines on sandstone, and the difficulty sits in the 5.10 to 5.11 range with most routes at 5.11, so it suits climbers who already lead the grade rather than newcomers. The wall catches plenty of sun, though summer leaf cover gives it some relief from the heat. Expect damp patches in spring, when seepage can limit the number of dry lines.

nc_brink_the.blurb: The Brink is a compact bouldering spot inside the Valley Boulderfield at Moore's Wall, in Hanging Rock State Park. A single large but low boulder sits on a steep slope, with about ten problems on quartzite. Most are easy to moderate, from VB up through V3, which makes it a friendly place to warm up, and a couple of V5 problems on the downhill face give stronger climbers something to try. Landings slope with the hillside, so bring pads and spotters.
